title: Saxl’s conjecture and universal tensor squares

result.label: Saxl’s conjecture and universal tensor squares
result.statement: Proves Saxl's conjecture: the tensor square of every staircase representation contains every irreducible complex representation of the corresponding symmetric group. More generally, every S n with n 2,4,9 has an irreducible representation whose tensor square contains all irreducibles.
